title: Make the event emitter type-safe
description: `src/emitter.ts` is an untyped event emitter full of `any` and `string`. Refactor it into a generic `Emitter<Events>` where `Events` maps event names to payload types, so that event names and payloads are checked at compile time (an event whose payload type is `undefined` is emitted without an argument). Runtime behaviour must stay the same. `test/emitter.test.ts` contains `// @ts-expect-error` lines that only pass if your types are strict enough; do not use `any`.
